lesson.title: Space Trip!
lesson.subtitle: Космос
lesson.intro: DJ Robo зовёт в космос! Узнаем, как по-английски планета, ракета и космонавт.
phrases: The rocket is going to the Moon.
I can see a planet in my telescope.

grammar.q: The Sun is ___ than the Moon.

why.biggest: biggest — «самый большой». Тут сравнивают двоих — bigger.

grammar.q: We are ___ to fly to the Moon.

why.go: Собираемся — are going to, нужна форма с -ing.
why.went: went — «пошли» в прошлом. Собираемся — going to.

reading.title: A Trip to the Moon
reading.text: Tom is an astronaut. Tomorrow he is going to fly to the Moon in a big rocket. The Moon is smaller than the Earth. From the Moon, Tom is going to see the blue Earth and many stars. He is going to take photos for his family.

questions.q: Is the Moon bigger than the Earth?
